first_lines: Use this guide to build and review a process with the people who run it. AIxRay is a local-file workbench
In Build a process, expand Lanes. Use clear role names for the teams and external parties who perform
the work. Lane type distinguishes People, Automation or AI agent, and External party. Enter a New lane
In the Build a process editor, add lanes and steps, choose each step's type and lane, and connect steps.
Use Exclusive gateway for decisions with conditional branches; label each condition and provide a default
Add Documents complete as an Exclusive gateway after the review. Connect a Complete default route to
Approve application and then End. Add a Missing documents conditional route to Provide missing

Under Compare processes and enter assumptions, select the before and future processes and enter

6 Run the agenda and parking lot
In Findings, open the Workshop subtab. Under Agenda, add items with an owner, minutes, and status;
use Save agenda to keep changes. Under Parking lot and actions, use Park a question, Add a note,
Under Agreed processes, select the current and future processes and choose Agree processes. Under
Checkpoint and pilot acceptance, record a reviewer and date, select accepted changes and unresolved
7 Review and share the pilot brief
From Workshop, choose Open pilot brief to go to Present and select Pilot brief. Review the agreed
processes, checkpoint status, acceptance criteria, accepted changes, unresolved issues, reviewed
Return to the project and choose Save a copy. Save the project file in the agreed location. Reopen that

Choose Work with an assistant from More actions. Select an assistant label, task, reviewed model
baseline, packet format, and account plan. For activity mapping, supply approved activity names. Review
